'''Selame''' was a maid in [[Salidar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Selame}}

== Appearance ==
She had a long nose and dark skin.

== History ==
She was [[Tairen]].

== Activities ==
[[Lelaine Akashi]] provided her maid Selame to serve [[Egwene al'Vere]] and report back anything she found out. It was her job to help undress Egwene.

She was murdered by [[Halima Saranov]] to pave way for herself.
